_comment: HAND-MAINTAINED. What every seat is allowed, seat x gate, as resolved by shared/policy_profile.py from tests/contract/policy_inputs.json (ss-console ADR 0093). A change to what any seat allows must change this file, so it shows up in review as a diff here. identifier_dates: block (a date must be read) | verify_recurring (a yearly date read from the record store verifies by month and day, this year or next). own_sources: seat-owned read tools the role treats as provenance sources (calendar_invite_list also verifies an invitation's own dates in the email that carries it); [] = none. checklist: paralegal | household (drops exclamation and caps_emphasis). floors: SSN, A-number, receipt number, case number and (case number, date) pair; always block, on every seat, not authorable.
